review_comments.body:
I imagine the intention of the original code here might have been to keep going after an error when there are multiple files provided for upload, but then the next check doesn't really support that theory. (@simonswine could perhaps chime in, if they remember).

In any case I think we can move forward with the proposed change (I doubt many people use the multi-file upload feature). A future improvement could be to collect all errors and return then at the end.
